rules.title: ffmpeg encodes without hardware acceleration

estimate.assumption: NVENC/VAAPI/QSV encodes are commonly 3-10x faster than x264 software at equal quality targets; 0.5 is conservative and only valid when a GPU exists

rules.why: Software x264/x265 uses all CPU cores for minutes per clip, and clips are re-encoded for each small change.
rules.fix: Use a hardware encoder if the machine has one; stream-copy (-c copy) for cuts; lower preset (-preset veryfast) and encode once at the end with a proxy (low-res) loop in between.

rules.title: Speech recognition with slow reference whisper

estimate.assumption: faster-whisper (CTranslate2, int8) is about 4x faster than reference whisper on CPU and 10x+ on GPU

rules.why: The reference PyTorch implementation is the slowest option, especially on CPU.
rules.fix: Use faster-whisper (int8 on CPU, float16 on GPU), batch files in one process so the model loads once, and prefer a GPU host for long audio.
rules.after: faster-whisper-xxl audio.mp3 --model medium   # or python: WhisperModel('medium', compute_type='int8')

rules.title: GPU job attempted on a machine without a GPU

detector.regex: CUDA is not available|No CUDA GPUs|no NVIDIA (GPU|driver)|NVIDIA-SMI has failed|nvidia-smi: command not found|Found no NVIDIA driver

estimate.assumption: time spent in the failed or CPU-fallback attempt is avoidable if the job is routed to a GPU host (or CPU-optimised) up front

rules.why: The environment has no usable GPU, so GPU-assuming commands fail or silently crawl on CPU.
rules.fix: Record 'no GPU here' once in the project instructions and route GPU jobs to a GPU host, or use int8/quantised CPU variants.
rules.before: python train.py --device cuda   # fails, then retried
rules.after: ssh gpu-host 'python train.py --device cuda'   # or --device cpu --compute int8

rules.title: Screenshots used where an accessibility snapshot would do

estimate.assumption: an image costs about 1500 input tokens and stays in context; a text snapshot of the same page is usually cheaper and queryable; half of the screenshots are assumed replaceable

rules.why: Images are expensive to carry and cannot be searched; the model needs structure, not pixels, for most browser steps.
rules.fix: Use the accessibility snapshot / DOM text for navigation and assertions; keep screenshots for visual checks only, at low frequency.
rules.after: browser_snapshot (text) after clicks; one screenshot at the end for visual QA
